title: The Message in the Blood Drop
intro: This quiz follows Mia and Ruby as they discover how blood and its tiny helpers work inside the body.

questions.explanation: Ruby was a red blood cell.

choices: To pump blood around the body

questions.prompt: Where do red blood cells pick up fresh oxygen?
questions.explanation: Red blood cells pick up fresh oxygen in the lungs.
